description: USE for one person's Magian Age Spread board seat: birth_date + as_of_date (completed civil years; no wall clock). NOT the 90-year Long Range Journey theme card; NOT get_date sky/calendars; NOT two-person scoring. RETURNS compact cosmic birth card + age_spread {age_civil, age_no (mod 90), age_aliases, age_spread_pos, planet_row, planet_col, is_fixed_card}. Feb-29 follows Postgres age(). Error as_of_before_birth when as_of_date < birth_date.

as_of_date.description: As-of civil date YYYY-MM-DD (pass host today when asking current age board)

birth_date.description: Civil birth date YYYY-MM-DD (month/day resolves Cosmic birth card)

name: get_age_spread
title: Magian Age seat (birth + as-of)
